fields.title: Live folder sync that scales to very large folders
fields.description: FOLDER-SCAN-PERF-1 Done-when 9(d), waived: on the owner's 120,190-file Drive folder a copied EPUB never reached the library, because every watcher event runs a full rescan and imports every file the library lacks, with one save at the end. Technical half: per-file add, remove and change without a rescan; a re-entry guard on `syncLibraryWithFolder`; batched saves that keep non-folder documents; a watcher closed flag and a cancellable startup timer (Fold-in 2a). Design half (owner): import everything, cap the import, or ask the user to choose subfolders.
fields.notes: Created by the FOLDER-SCAN-PERF-1 close-out 2026-10-14 (owner ruling; placement Seq 15 by planner ruling). Stub. The technical half does not depend on the owner's large-folder answer and may be spec'd and dispatched first, split from the design half. The owner keeps sourceFolder cleared until this lands. Evidence: `docs/governance/close-outs/CloseOut.FOLDER-SCAN-PERF-1.2026-10-14.md`.
